::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 5 minutes\
**Cook time:** 10 minutes

[Main]{.badge .badge-main}
:::

*Simple, easy, delicious.*

## Ingredients

- 2 catfish filets
- 1½ tsp garlic salt
- 1½ tsp paprika
- black pepper (to taste)

## Instructions

1. Season fish to your liking on both sides. Use pepper generously.
2. Cook on medium-high heat in olive oil for approximately 3 minutes on each side, or until done. Cast iron skillet will produce the best results.
